text: Sections 18ZO(1), (1A) and (1B) deal with three distinct situations – i) where the offender is on a Magistrates’ Court DATO and is charged with an offence within the jurisdiction of the Magistrates’ Court; ii) where the offender is on a County Court DATO, is charged with an offence within the jurisdiction of the Magistrates’ Court and pleads guilty; and iii) where the offender is on a County Court DATO and is charged with an offence within the jurisdiction of the County Court. If scenario two occurs the Magistrates division must transfer the charges to the County Court division.
